facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's Emily Hohman, approximately 75% of ad campaign spend happens in the 10 weeks leading up to an election day.
facts.quote: approximately 75% of ad campaign spend happens in the 10 weeks leading up to an election day

facts.fact: In a StackAdapt client case study, Kinetic Strategies reached 158,075 voters in Texas' 16th district ahead of the 2022 mid-term election using a waterfall strategy.
Per the article, a Washington DC DMA TV buy can also reach people in Maryland, Virginia, and parts of West Virginia and Pennsylvania where they cannot vote in DC elections.
facts.quote: you could still be targeting people in Maryland and Virginia, and even parts of West Virginia and Pennsylvania

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that voter files are uploaded to the data collaboration platform LiveRamp, then hashed and sent back to LiveRamp for processing.
facts.quote: voter files are uploaded directly to the data collaboration platform, LiveRamp, and then are hashed and sent back to LiveRamp for processing

facts.fact: The article names L2, Tunnl, TargetSmart, and i360 as political data providers whose segments can supplement voter file data on StackAdapt.
facts.quote: supplement it with segments from key political data providers such as L2, Tunnl, TargetSmart, and i360
